scope: Full Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; no native, metadata, device or release certification.

changes.before: ဖိနပ်အရင်စစ်ပြီး နောက်တစ်ဂိမ်းလျှောက်ဖို့မေးကာ အရေအတွက်မတိုးကြောင်း ပြောပါ။ ဂျပန်လို ပြောပါ။
changes.after: ဖိနပ်အရင်အံကိုက်စစ်ပြီး အဲဒီနောက် ပထမဆုံးတစ်ဂိမ်းပဲ လျှောက်ဖို့ ဆွေးနွေးကာ ဂိမ်းအရေအတွက်ကို ကြိုမတိုးထားကြောင်း ပြောပါ။ ဂျပန်လို ပြောပါ။

changes.before: Ibalik ang sapatos at ipatingin ang hindi kasya dahil baka lumuwag ang kaliwa kung parehong lalaki. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.
changes.after: Ibalik ang sapatos at hilinging suriin kung saan hindi kasya, dahil baka lumuwag ang kaliwa kung palalakihin ang sukat ng parehong sapatos. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

changes.before: Unahin ang pagsusuri ng sapatos at saka magtanong sa isang game lamang muna. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.
changes.after: Sabihing uunahin ang pagsusuri kung kasya ang sapatos, saka magtatanong tungkol sa pagpapalista sa isang game muna at hindi muna magdadagdag ng game. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

changes.before: ยอมรับว่าเคยคิดว่าทะเบียนบริษัทกับธนาคารจะเปลี่ยนอัตโนมัติ และจะติดต่อแต่ละผู้ส่งแยกต่างหาก กรุณาพูดเป็นภาษาญี่ปุ่น
changes.after: ยอมรับว่าเคยคิดว่าที่อยู่ที่ลงทะเบียนกับบริษัทและธนาคารจะเปลี่ยนอัตโนมัติ และบอกว่าจะติดต่อผู้ส่งแต่ละแห่งแยกจากการปรึกษาไปรษณีย์ กรุณาพูดเป็นภาษาญี่ปุ่น

changes.before: Amining inakalang awtomatikong mababago ang kumpanya at bangko at sabihing hiwalay silang kokontakin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.
changes.after: Amining inakala mong awtomatikong mababago ang rehistradong address sa kumpanya at bangko, at sabihing kokontakin mo sila nang hiwalay sa konsultasyon sa koreo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

changes.before: Hiwalay po ninyong gawin ang pagkontak sa mga nagpapadala at ang konsultasyon dito. Makikinig muna kayo sa kawani bago sabay na isumite ang para sa lahat, tama po ba?
changes.after: Hiwalay po ninyong gawin ang pagkontak sa mga nagpapadala at ang konsultasyon sa counter na ito. Huwag munang magsumite nang sabay para sa lahat; makinig muna sa paliwanag ng kawani, maaari po ba?

changes.before: Hãy báo người phụ trách và xác nhận người cùng địa chỉ áp dụng. Anh/chị viết riêng địa chỉ cũ mới và kế hoạch chuyển từng người được không?
changes.after: Hãy báo tình hình đó cho người phụ trách rồi xác nhận những ai và địa chỉ nào thuộc diện làm thủ tục. Anh/chị có thể viết riêng địa chỉ cũ, địa chỉ mới và kế hoạch chuyển nhà của từng người không?

changes.before: 我會先諮詢，再填全家人的名字。我想用分開記載本人資料和家人未定事項的筆記，確認對象和辦理方式。
changes.after: 我會在一併填寫所有人的姓名之前先諮詢。我想用分開記載本人資料和家人未定事項的筆記，確認對象和辦理方式。

changes.before: 決定先諮詢再填全員姓名，並用區分本人與家人未定事項的筆記確認對象和流程。請用日語表達。
changes.after: 決定在一併填寫所有人的姓名之前先諮詢，並用區分本人與家人未定事項的筆記確認對象和辦理方式。請用日語表達。

changes.before: नुहाउने टिकट छ, हैन? पस्नुअघि सोध्ने छ?
changes.after: तपाईंसँग नुहाउने टिकट रहेछ। भित्र पस्नुअघि पुष्टि गर्न चाहनुभएको कुनै कुरा छ?

changes.before: यो टिकटले पस्छु। तौलिया भित्र पाउँछु ठानेर केही ल्याइनँ।
changes.after: म यो टिकट लिएर भित्र पस्ने सोचमा छु। तौलिया भित्र पाइन्छ भन्ने ठानेर केही पनि ल्याएको छैन।

changes.before: टिकट चलाउने तर तौलिया भित्र पाउने ठानी नल्याएको बताउनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.after: नुहाउने टिकट प्रयोग गर्ने तर भित्र तौलिया पाइन्छ भन्ने ठानेर साथमा नल्याएको कुरा बताउनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।

changes.before: टिकटमा नुहाउने मात्र छ। तौलियाको सूचना यो बिक्रीमा अलग छ।
changes.after: टिकटमा नुहाउने टिकट भनेर मात्रै लेखिएको छ। तौलियाको सूचना भने यहाँको बिक्री कक्षमा छुट्टै राखिएको छ।

changes.before: तौलियासहित ठानेको थिएँ। यो सापट कि घर लैजाने हो?
changes.after: टिकटमा तौलिया पनि समावेश छ भन्ने ठानेको थिएँ। यो सूचनामा देखाइएको तौलिया सापट लिने हो कि घर लैजान मिल्ने हो?

changes.before: टिकटमा तौलिया ठानेको बुझाई अलग सूचना सापट वा बिक्री सोध्नुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.after: टिकटमा तौलिया पनि समावेश छ भन्ने ठानेको बुझाउँदै छुट्टै सूचनामा देखाइएको तौलिया भाडामा दिने हो कि बिक्री गर्ने हो भनेर सोध्नुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।

changes.before: यो बेच्ने तौलिया लेखिएको हो। टिकटमा पर्नेबाट छुट्याएर हेर्नुहोस्।
changes.after: यो सूचनामा बिक्रीका लागि तौलिया भनेर लेखिएको छ। यसलाई तपाईंसँग भएको टिकटमा समावेश चीजहरूभन्दा छुट्टै बुझ्नुहोस्।

changes.before: आफ्नो तौलिया होटलमा छ। फर्केर ल्याउने सोच पनि छ, तर आज यहाँ एक किन्न चाहन्छु।
changes.after: आफ्नो तौलिया बस्ने ठाउँमै छोडेर आएको छु। लिन फर्कने कि भनेर सोच्दै छु, तर आज यहाँ एउटा किन्न चाहन्छु।

changes.before: निजी होटलमा भए पनि आज एक किन्ने चाहना बताउनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.after: आफ्नो तौलिया बस्ने ठाउँमा रहेको, लिन फर्कने विकल्प पनि भए पनि आज यहाँ एउटा किन्न चाहेको कुरा बताउनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।

changes.before: त्यसो भए किन्ने वस्तु यहाँ हेर्नुहोस्। किन्नुअघि नपढिने लेबल छ?
changes.after: त्यसो भए किन्न चाहनुभएको सामान यहाँ हेर्नुहोस्। किन्नुअघि सूचनामा पढ्न गाह्रो भएको कुनै भाग छ?

changes.before: सानो एक लिन्छु। टिकटभन्दा अलग तिर्ने रहेछ। तौलियाको मूल्य यहीँ पक्का चाहन्छु।
changes.after: सानो तौलिया एउटा लिन्छु। यसको पैसा नुहाउने टिकटभन्दा छुट्टै तिर्नुपर्ने रहेछ, है? तौलियाको मूल्य यहीँ पुष्टि गर्न चाहन्छु।

changes.before: सानो एक रोजी टिकटभन्दा अलग र मूल्य पक्का गर्नुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.after: सानो तौलिया एउटा छानेर नुहाउने टिकटभन्दा छुट्टै भुक्तानी गर्नुपर्ने कुरा र त्यही सामानको मूल्य पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।

changes.before: हेरेँ। यो एक किनेर पस्छु। टिकटले मात्र पाउने होइन बुझेँ।
changes.after: मैले सूचना हेरेँ। यो तौलिया एउटा किनेर भित्र पस्छु। नुहाउने टिकट मात्रै देखाएर पाउने सामान होइन भन्ने बुझेँ।

changes.before: लेबल पढी एक किन्ने तय र टिकट मात्रले नपाउने पक्का गर्नुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.after: सूचना पढेर तौलिया एउटा किन्ने निर्णय गरेको र नुहाउने टिकट मात्रै देखाएर तौलिया नपाइने कुरा पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।

changes.before: लियौँ। तौलियाको हिसाब यहीँ। टिकट पनि नहराई राख्नुहोस्। क्यासमा आउनुहोस्।
changes.after: बुझेँ। तौलियाको भुक्तानी यहाँ लिन्छौँ। नुहाउने टिकट पनि नहराउने गरी आफूसँग राख्नुहोस्। अब भुक्तानीका लागि यहाँ आउनुहोस्।

changes.before: बाहिरबाट प्रदर्शन मात्र हेरेको हुँ, नियन्त्रण भाग छोएको छैन। नम्बर मिलाउन भनेर आफैँ अभिलेख पनि सच्याएको छैन।
changes.after: बाहिरबाट डिस्प्ले मात्रै हेरेको हुँ, नियन्त्रण भाग छोएको छैन। नम्बर मिलाउन भनेर आफैँ अभिलेख पनि सच्याएको छैन।

changes.before: बाहिरबाट प्रदर्शन मात्रै हेरेको, नियन्त्रण भाग नछोएको र अभिलेखको नम्बर आफैँ नसच्याएको बताउनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.after: बाहिरबाट डिस्प्ले मात्रै हेरेको, नियन्त्रण भाग नछोएको र अभिलेखको नम्बर आफैँ नसच्याएको बताउनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।

changes.before: Number three po sa tala, pero number four ang sinabing ako ang hahawak. Gusto kong ipaalam ang kawalan ng dahilan ng paghinto at ang pagkakaiba ng numero.
changes.after: Number three po ang nasa tala, pero number four ang sinabing ako ang hahawak. Gusto kong ipaalam kapwa ang hindi nakasulat na dahilan ng paghinto at ang hindi magtugmang numero.

changes.before: Ghi chép là máy số ba nhưng tôi nghe sẽ nhận máy số bốn. Tôi muốn báo cả lý do dừng và số thiết bị không khớp.
changes.after: Ghi chép là máy số ba nhưng tôi nghe sẽ nhận máy số bốn. Tôi muốn báo cả việc ô lý do dừng để trống và số thiết bị không khớp.

changes.before: Hari ini saya tidak akan memotret. Saya akan menulis nama bahan rujukan dan nomor pameran di buku catatan agar bisa menelitinya lagi setelah kunjungan.
changes.after: Hari ini saya tidak akan memotret. Saya akan menulis nama bahan rujukan dan nomor objek pameran di buku catatan agar bisa menelitinya lagi setelah kunjungan.

changes.before: Sampaikan bahwa Anda tidak akan memotret hari ini dan akan mencatat nama bahan rujukan serta nomor pameran untuk diteliti kembali nanti. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.after: Sampaikan bahwa Anda tidak akan memotret hari ini dan akan mencatat nama bahan rujukan serta nomor objek pameran untuk diteliti kembali nanti. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.

changes.before: Sa diagram pong ito, ang putol-putol na linya ay larawang muling binuo. Hiwalay iyon sa linya ng kasalukuyang puwedeng bisitahin. Aling bahagi po ang gusto ninyong makita?
changes.after: Sa diagram pong ito ng eksibit, ang putol-putol na linya ay nagpapakita ng isang inilarawang rekonstruksiyon. Iba ito sa mga linya para sa mga lugar na puwedeng bisitahin ngayon. Aling bahagi po ang gusto ninyong makita?

changes.before: Sumasakit po ang likod ko mula nang magbuhat ako ng kahon sa trabaho kahapon. Unang punta ko rito, kaya gusto kong malaman kung saan ikukuwento ang nangyari.
changes.after: Sumasakit po ang ibabang bahagi ng likod ko mula nang magbuhat ako ng mga kahon sa trabaho kahapon. Unang punta ko rito, kaya gusto kong malaman kung saan ikukuwento kung paano nagsimula at nagpatuloy ang sakit.

changes.before: Sabihin ang pananakit ng likod matapos magbuhat sa trabaho at itanong kung saan ikukuwento sa unang konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.
changes.after: Sabihin na sumasakit ang ibabang bahagi ng likod mo matapos magbuhat ng mga kahon sa trabaho, at itanong kung saan ikukuwento ang takbo ng mga sintomas sa unang konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

changes.before: Tôi sẽ nối với người khám để kể diễn biến. Tôi đưa phiếu ghi đau hiện tại, anh/chị có thể ngồi điền không?
changes.after: Chúng tôi sẽ chuyển anh/chị tới nhân viên y tế để trình bày diễn biến triệu chứng. Tôi sẽ đưa phiếu để ghi tình trạng đau hiện tại; anh/chị có thể ngồi điền được không?

changes.before: Vậy tôi không hứa với công ty là hôm nay chắc chắn có, mà hỏi tên giấy cần trước. Tôi sẽ nêu việc này riêng với tư vấn đau.
changes.after: Vậy tôi không hứa với công ty là hôm nay chắc chắn được cấp giấy, mà sẽ hỏi trước tên giấy tờ cần thiết. Tôi sẽ trình bày yêu cầu giấy tờ như một việc riêng với việc trao đổi về triệu chứng đau.

changes.before: Anh/chị giữ bao bên mình để kiểm tra được nhé. Tôi sẽ nối với y tá, xin chờ một chút.
changes.after: Anh/chị giữ bao bì bên mình để nhân viên có thể xem nhé. Chúng tôi sẽ mời y tá tiếp nhận, xin chờ một chút.

reviewCriteria.contextNotes: Consecutive seat numbers versus same-side adjacency; mother difficulty hearing explanations; no assumed swaps; requery before purchase.
Lift under inspection, no restart guarantee; stairs-free alternative, rest stop without obstruction; verify other lift; no departure guarantee.
Receipt name differs; preserve as received and protect third-party privacy; receipt correction distinct from employer proof-of-visit requirements.
Meal relationship discovered yesterday distinct from unknown symptom onset; nurse does not diagnose; choose suitable department without self-diagnosis; report changes.
Concentrated soup needs preparation; ingredient small print; milk allergy check by label not photograph; do not sample; note separate storage instructions/contact.
Per100g comparison versus tax-inclusive bag total; small quantity for one; loose fruit label distinct from bag label; check item name and total at checkout.
Full container versus refill pouch; match product name/capacity; tax-inclusive full-container price; storage shelf constraint; ask before checkout if mismatch.
Bag capacity changes after added beverages; remove two before finalizing; no heating; confirm removed items absent from list; cash sufficiency before inserting coins.
Two notices same address can require separate handling; response notice priority; friend accompaniment not official interpreting; preferences not confirmed arrangements.
Correct address but unknown addressee; do not assume prior resident; distinguish sender and recipient; unopened handling, date not own deadline; no independent disposal/forwarding.
Tracking movement not proof of contents; keep material copies; recipient determines record requirements; unsealed originals taken home, no dispatch accepted.
Old incoming label reverses outgoing sender/recipient; replace before attaching; measure present box rather than rely on old fee; arrival estimate not guaranteed.
Employer deadline does not guarantee account opening; abbreviated name discrepancy on separate note without editing original; bank screening separate employer conditions; explain then sign.
Rent coverage month, payment deadline, desired transfer date distinct; confirm with management not bank; rent/common fee sum separate bank fee; no current/scheduled transfer.
Evidence-based reconstructed model not relocated original; distinguish confirmed and inferred detail; model photo permission does not extend adjacent prohibited area; bag in front.
Low battery prevents reliance on phone return map; short out-and-back path instead of full circuit; rest/turnback optional; entrance circle/rest square; ask staff rather than guess.
Purchased towel versus rented towel; rental fee not take-home right; used return slot separate unused basket; no bath photography even empty; message outside and locate key/towel return.
Goshuin display sample distinct from separate prewritten sheet; no direct book writing today; request one person, friend preference separate; clear queue, no reception photos, check outside signs.
Two gates, red noticeboard versus white information board; proposed one waits/one moves requires agreement; clear passage and inform friend slight shift; no silent gate change.
Full route ends at different exit; leaf comparison section priority then turnback; entrance-name signage distinct other-exit arrow; use exact name with pickup person and wait reply.

Certificate issuance separate address registration; document title not personal name; residence card/address note not automatically sufficient; ask missing items/deadline; queue ticket not completion.
Contracting person, guarantor and housemate separate; recipient requirements and certificate contents align; avoid unnecessary information, no assumed proxy application.

Appointment change consultation only; consultation and test both require confirmation; preparation applicable date not self-edited; unchanged condition does not establish safe delay; retain original slip until new date confirmed.

Dizziness term unclear, no forced label; unsteadiness when rising distinct from spinning; intermittent frequency and duration unmeasured, no one-second claim; distinguish observation/unknowns, no nurse diagnosis; confirm questionnaire at consultation.

Similar capacity bottles compared by internal cleaning and lid parts; own brush may not fit, pictured brush absent from accessory list; note external dimensions for bag; distinguish display sample/boxed stock; no purchase today.

Family gift; usual size letter not fit guarantee; compare garment width/length with recipient clothes, not own try-on; exchange requirements checked, no waived conditions/guarantee; preserve receipt; no payment/wrapping before fit decision.

Two calendar days equal one night, not two; desired departure one day later than booked; extra night/same room not guaranteed; check move/total added cost/breakfast morning separately; retain original one-night reservation during inquiry.

Multiple same-surname bookings; match confirmation number and own two-person/one-night details, never mix other guest three-person data; existing breakfast only retained; inquire dinner availability and one/two-person costs before any addition.

Recorded feeding explanation distinct from current live demonstration; scheduled model talk not visitor feeding; no self feeding with brought food; limited standing, rear area must leave path clear; seated recording alternative; no photography during talk.

Windblown hat beyond rope; proximity/visibility never establishes entry permission; report position without crossing or reaching long object; no retrieval/time promise; wait information-center side, not restricted entrance; weather instructions may change, no solo pursuit.
